svg.title: How a lot page stays live
svg.desc: A sequence diagram generated by Archify.

g.text: nearest edge; the fastest sets the page clock
anonymous; it only sends a keepalive
one read for every page joining at once

g.data-edge-label: hello: the lot at its version

g.text: hello: the lot at its version
after the commit; a lost one only costs time
every page within 100 ms; the alarm re-arms
at the effective close; pages show Closing

g.data-edge-label: extends or closes under the lock

g.text: extends or closes under the lock
idempotent; a later touch or the cron does the same
the room re-arms from the lot it read
